period_note: SOLO/SEPARATE basis (the 'Condensed Balance Sheet'/'Condensed Profit & Loss Account' pages headed just 'Eastern Bank PLC.', as distinct from the 'Condensed Consolidated' pages earlier in the same PDF). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (the filing's own column header reads '01 January 2026 to 31 March 2026'), flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as CITYBANK's schema example. For Q1 specifically, cumulative-from-Jan-1 and discrete-quarter are numerically identical (first quarter of the year). EXTRACTION NOTE: this PDF's Solo-section font has a broken ToUnicode CMap — pdftotext -layout systematically mis-renders digits in that section only (e.g. '1'/'L', '5'/'s', '0'/'O' confusable; the Consolidated section earlier in the same file extracts cleanly). All figures below were therefore sourced via OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract) of the Solo Balance Sheet/P&L/notes pages (physical PDF pages 7-9 and 16), not the raw pdftotext dump. Cross-validated three ways: (1) internal arithmetic — operating_income - operating_expenses = operating_profit exactly (7,714,488,947 - 3,547,765,881 = 4,166,723,066); operating_profit - total_provision = PBT exactly (4,166,723,066 - 510,282,967 = 3,656,440,099); PBT - tax = PAT exactly (3,656,440,099 - 1,653,976,362 = 2,002,463,737); assets = liabilities + equity exactly (716,554,099,166 + 53,052,753,521 = 769,606,852,687); classified_loans/gross_loans = 12,780,834,930/457,218,145,190 = 2.795%, matching the filing's own reported NPL% of 2.80%. (2) the comparative '31 December 2025' column in this filing matches bank_financials/EBL/quarterly/2025_Q4.json exactly for every line item checked (total_assets 761,604m, gross_loans 477,040m, total_deposits 556,454m, total_equity 50,850m, investments_securities 211,473m, borrowings 113,440m, fixed_assets 6,791m, classified_loans 10,675m, npl_pct 2.24% — no discrepancy). (3) cross-checked against the later 2026 H1 filing's own comparative Q1 columns and its discrete 'April-June 2026' column: Q1 PAT (2,002,463,737) + H1 filing's discrete Q2-only PAT (2,288,522,963) = 4,290,986,700, matching the H1 filing's cumulative H1 PAT (4,290,986,700) exactly.
